Store the list as an array and treat it as immutable: every change creates a new array. Keep past (an array of earlier arrays) and future (undone arrays).
commit(next): push the current list onto past, set the list to next, and empty future. Undo: push the current onto future and pop past. Redo is the mirror.
Give each note a unique key (a counter) so removing one doesn't confuse the rendering. For keys, listen to keydown on a wrapper element and check event.ctrlKey with event.key 'z' or 'y'.
